artifact: Development fixture controls for E08, E33 and E74
method: Ran the pre-repair oracles from the pinned commit on the listed maintained negative controls.
Ran each current manifest sample through its fixture oracle with the trusted self-test flag. The declared expected exit and actual process exit are recorded below.

Copied one accepted alternative per fixture outside the checkout, added an assertion that a host-only file is inaccessible, left the self-test flag on, and invoked the same fixture entry points. Also ran the original E74 input suite through the isolated runner.
Invoked the same copied candidates with Docker absent from PATH to check that the host did not execute them.

Staged the maintained E74 equivalent/search.py as the reference in a separate fixture checkout. The file-backed suite still accepted the equivalent SQL and detected both faults through the isolated runner.
scope: The fixture checks cover the specified scheduler, dependency-failure, and SQL behaviors on ordinary candidate suites.

E74 records a synchronous native sqlite3 execute returning during the owned search in a particular pytest item. The ranking check requires that item to pass on the reference, fail under ascending order and record the SQLite observation on both runs. This gives per-test evidence with no independent trace of each assertion's inputs.
Candidate code and reports share the isolated process environment. Deliberate report tampering is outside these checks.
